skill.summary: AI chibi maker — convert a photo into a cute chibi character sticker

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of chibi-maker-cli-skill.
- Instantly converts photos into cute chibi character stickers using the WeShop CLI.
- Requires the weshop-cli tool and a valid WESHOP_API_KEY.
- Supports custom prompts for chibi style and batch processing.
- Example usage provided for easy setup and operation.
